content: Mastodon: instances can disable unauthenticated timeline access (AUTHORIZED_FETCH / 'disable public preview'; Mastodon 4.5 adds granular per-timeline controls) — anonymous GET /api/v1/timelines/public or /tag/:tag then returns 401/422; limit param max is 40 per request; remote=false/local=true flags change scope; public unauth ceiling commonly 300 req/5min per IP; behavior varies per instance so tools must degrade with a clear per-instance error, not a hard failure.
